meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 处理 LazyCodex/Codex bug 时,Claude 在临时副本复现,先写失败测试,做最小修复并验证;对 openai/codex 开 fork PR,对 code-yeongyu/lazycodex 只发带补丁的 issue。
howto.when: 当你说要修复 bug、为 bug 开 PR 或调试并提交 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复这个 LazyCodex bug
say.note: Claude 会先复现、测试再交付修复。

say.text: 给 openai/codex 的这个 bug 开个 PR
say.note: 它会在临时副本里验证后再创建 PR。

say.text: lazycodex-ai 的这个报错能修吗
say.note: 会为它创建带补丁的 issue。

howto.what_en: On LazyCodex/Codex bugs, Claude reproduces it in a temp clone, writes a failing test, applies the smallest fix, and verifies. For openai/codex it opens a fork PR; for code-yeongyu/lazycodex it files an issue with a patch, no PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to fix a bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Help me fix this LazyCodex bug.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces, tests, and delivers a fix.

say_en.text: Open a PR for this openai/codex bug.
say_en.note: It verifies on a temp clone, then creates a fork PR.

say_en.text: Can this lazycodex-ai error be fixed?
say_en.note: It will create an issue with the patch.
